correction_reason: V1 overclaimed universal historical no-separate-commission continuity from 2022 plus current endpoint evidence. V2 binds additional official annual Pepperstone EU documents and retains unresolved point-in-time continuity between documented versions.

sources.title: Attain symbol data - historical tick data
facts: ProtoOAGetTickDataReq accepts symbolId, BID/ASK quote type, fromTimestamp and toTimestamp.
One historical tick request may not span more than 604800000 milliseconds (one week).
ProtoOAGetTickDataRes returns tickData and hasMore when the backend response is truncated.
Historical tick prices are raw tick values divided by 100000.

sources.title: Open API getting started / rate limits
facts: Historical requests are limited to 5 requests per second per connection.

US500.reason: Multiple official annual/current documents consistently state no separate index commission, but this checkpoint does not possess an immutable effective-date archive proving that policy at every intervening timestamp.

non_promotion_rules: Matching official policy snapshots are not silently treated as exact point-in-time continuity between document effective dates.
Current/recent average or minimum spreads are not historical paths or adverse upper bounds.
No numeric slippage bound is selected before candidate-independent quote evidence is acquired.
Unknown-period separate commission is not assumed to be zero merely because documented endpoints agree.
